title: 6-Layer Odd-Quarter-Wave Perturbed Initialization with Enhanced Step-Size
scientific_hypothesis: The 0.0012 performance ceiling in prior 6-layer optimizations stems from sampling-bound local minima rather than structural limits; structured odd-quarter-wave initialization with ±15nm alternating perturbations in the 200-300nm thickness band, coupled with increased optimizer step-size, will escape shallow minima and improve best_target_score.
design_principle: Odd-quarter-wave thickness sequences create asymmetric interference conditions that broaden dual-band transmission windows; deliberate perturbations on alternating layers break symmetry to access previously unexplored regions of the thickness parameter space.
proposed_topology: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Silicon substrate (6 finite layers, alternating high-low sequence starting with Ta2O5)
soft_objectives: minimize average reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band
minimize average reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm
materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2
thickness tolerance sensitivity analysis recommended post-optimization
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference
Quarter-wave stack theory modified for dual-band operation
expected_advantages: Structured initialization avoids random search inefficiency
Alternating perturbations target observed variance band (200-300nm)
Increased step-size enables escape from shallow local minima
known_risks: May converge to similar local optimum if structural limit is genuine
Larger step-size may overshoot narrow optima
6-layer degrees of freedom may be fundamentally insufficient for dual-band
execution_request_english: Optimize a 6-layer anti-reflection coating on silicon substrate with air incidence at 0 degrees, unpolarized light. Stack sequence: Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 (6 finite layers). Wavelength bands: 1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm. Initialize thicknesses using odd-quarter-wave sequence centered at 250 nm optical thickness, apply ±15 nm perturbation on alternating layers (layers 1, 3, 5: +15 nm; layers 2, 4, 6: -15 nm). Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with step-size multiplier increased to 2.0x baseline. Thickness bounds: 20-400 nm per layer. Objective: minimize weighted average reflectance across both bands, report transmittance into silicon. Exclude previously tested thickness fingerprints: 730f5e44ee20783a, dd540b50edff0d0f, 3171e6f7a12074fe, 8e5fabfdc1c26c60, 3eb0b207ce0785d0, 072959648a8bb226, 26c3ff311537571b, 7a30d797ac6e6808, 63c19962355fa149, 8ddf6036747aaf5f, 4ce1ec7e3b0f4657, 2cb54722fc9896cc. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 1260-1360 nm, 1530-1565 nm. soft objectives: low average reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band; low average reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflection in the specified bands. manufacturing constraints: maximum 12 layers; individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm; materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2.
